interchangeable throttle-grip guide plates (grey and black) that change the throttle-opening characteristic

records.topic: owner's-manual engine management and map options
records.statement: KTM's 2021 owner's manual for the 250 XC-W / 300 XC-W (transfer-port fuel injection (TPI)) describes an ignition-map plug-in connector under the fuel tank: disconnected = Soft map (better rideability), joined = Performance map (higher performance); a handlebar map switch (Performance / Soft ignition maps) that the manual lists only for All special models; the model itself uses the plug-in connector; interchangeable throttle-grip guide plates (grey and black) that change the throttle-opening characteristic; a procedure to program ambient air pressure into the injection system.

tips: fit a steel rear sprocket in sand and mud
fit the air-filter dust/sand cover on dry sand
fit the air-filter rain cover in wet sand, mud and snow

records.topic: owner's-manual preparation for sand, mud, heat and cold
records.statement: KTM's 2023 owner's manual for the 250 XC-W / 300 XC-W gives condition-specific preparation for dry sand, wet sand, wet and muddy tracks, heat / slow technical riding, cold / snow: fit a steel rear sprocket in sand and mud; fit the air-filter dust/sand cover on dry sand; fit the air-filter rain cover in wet sand, mud and snow; check the air filter about every 30 minutes in difficult conditions; with regular use in sand change the piston every 10 operating hours; in heat or slow riding gear the bike down (lower secondary ratio) because frequent clutch use heats the oil.

tips: fit a steel rear sprocket in sand and mud
fit the air-filter dust/sand cover on dry sand
fit the air-filter rain cover in wet sand, mud and snow

with regular use in sand change the piston every 10 operating hours
in heat or slow riding gear the bike down (lower secondary ratio) because frequent clutch use heats the oil

records.topic: gearing changes offered by the manufacturer
records.statement: GasGas's 2021 owner's manual for the EC 250 / EC 300 lists stock final drive 14:52 (EC 250 EU) and rear sprockets of 45, 48, 49, 50, 51, 52 teeth as available; for heat or slow riding the manual says to gear down (lower secondary ratio) because frequent clutch use overheats the oil.

source.name: GasGas Owner's Manual 2021 EC 250 EC 300 (art. no. 3215011en)

records.notes: Gearing is the simplest engine-feel modification: a bigger rear sprocket shortens every gear.

records.topic: effect of each listed rear sprocket (calculated)
records.statement: Worked out from the 2021 EC 250 / EC 300 stock 14:52 gearing, each manufacturer-listed rear sprocket changes every gear's overall ratio by: 14:45 -13.5%, 14:48 -7.7%, 14:49 -5.8%, 14:50 -3.8%, 14:51 -1.9%, 14:52 0.0% (positive = shorter gearing, more acceleration and less top speed; one rear tooth is roughly 2%).

source.name: BAK MX calculation from the manufacturer owner's-manual sprocket list

records.notes: Change = (new rear / front) / (stock rear / front) - 1, front sprocket unchanged.

records.statement: Worked out from GasGas's 2021 EC 250 / EC 300 gear ratios: rpm drops on each upshift are about 1st-2nd 28.9%, 2nd-3rd 23.1%, 3rd-4th 16.4%, 4th-5th 15.8%, 5th-6th 12.6%, and the overall spread from 1st to 6th is 2.97:1. Larger drops mean the engine falls further down its powerband after a shift.

source.name: BAK MX calculation from the manufacturer owner's-manual gear ratios

records.notes: Drop = 1 - ratio(n+1)/ratio(n), the fractional rpm fall when shifting up at constant road speed.

records.statement: GasGas's 2021 owner's manual for the EC 250 / EC 300 supplies two throttle-grip guide plates - grey and black - that change how quickly the throttle opens; the manual says the grey plate opens the throttle valve more slowly.

source.name: GasGas Owner's Manual 2021 EC 250 EC 300 (art. no. 3215011en)

records.topic: rear-wheel dyno: 2023 300 TBI engine (measured on the 300 SX)
records.statement: On a rear-wheel Dynojet 250i the 2023 KTM 300 SX, which shares the TBI 300 engine data with the 2023 300 XC and TX 300 in the owner's manuals, made 48.8 hp at 8,100 rpm and 32.2 lb-ft at 7,500 rpm; the test rider described a strong bottom end that lets you run a taller gear.

source.name: Dirt Rider - How Much Power Does the 2023 KTM 300 SX Make? (Dynojet 250i)

records.notes: Measured on the SX sister model. The 2023 owner's manuals list identical bore, stroke, Z dimension and primary drive for the 300 SX, 300 XC and TX 300, but XC/TX ECU calibration and gearing differ, so treat the figure as indicative.

records.topic: second dyno source: 2023 300 TBI engine (300 SX, different dyno)
records.statement: A second magazine dyno measured the stock 2023 KTM 300 SX at 54.96 hp at 8,560 rpm and 35.38 lb-ft at 7,450 rpm on the green map; testers called the stock delivery linear and "luggy" low to mid with little bottom hit. Different dynos read differently, so compare only within one source.

source.name: Motocross Action - MXA team tested: FMF 2023 KTM 250/300SX pipe/silencer

records.notes: Same engine family as the 2023 300 XC / TX 300 (shared owner's-manual engine data). Kept side by side with the 48.8 hp reading from another dyno - see conflicts.

records.topic: rear-wheel dyno: 2025 300 TBI engine (measured on the 300 SX)
records.statement: On a rear-wheel Dynojet 250i the 2025 KTM 300 SX made 49.1 hp and 32.3 lb-ft, 1.3 hp less than a 350 SX-F but 5.7 lb-ft more torque; the 300 XC and TX 300 use the same TBI engine data in their 2024-2027 owner's manuals.

source.name: Dirt Rider - How Much Power Does the 2025 KTM 300 SX Make? (Dynojet 250i)

records.notes: Measured on the SX; applied to XC/TX years whose owner's manuals list the same bore, stroke, Z dimension and primary drive. Map and gearing differ, so treat as indicative.

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2026 300 XC
records.statement: KTM describes the 2026 300 XC as a 300 cc two-stroke for racers wanting maximum power at the least weight, with two maps on the standard switch: Map 1 gives linear, predictable delivery and Map 2 "crisp, explosive power output"; weight without fuel is listed as 101.8 kg.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2026 KTM 300 XC

records.notes: The model page lists 101.8 kg while the 2026 owner's manual lists 103 kg for all XC models - see conflicts.

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2024 300 XC
records.statement: KTM says the 2024 300 XC comes with a map select switch as standard: Map 1 for linear, predictable power and Map 2 for crisp, explosive output; the power valve is auto-calibrating so it never needs adjusting. Weight without fuel 102.1 kg.

source.name: KTM Canada model page - 2024 KTM 300 XC (French)

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2027 125 XC
records.statement: KTM describes the 2027 125 XC as unmatched power with lightweight construction; a standard map switch gives Map 1 (linear, predictable) and Map 2 (more aggressive); weight without fuel 94.8 kg.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2027 KTM 125 XC

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2023 125 XC
records.statement: KTM says the 2023 125 XC likes to rev but is surprisingly responsive when needed, and claims more torque than any 125 cc two-stroke before it; Mode 1 gives linear, predictable delivery and Mode 2 more explosive power. Weight without fuel 93.1 kg.

source.name: KTM Canada model page - 2023 KTM 125 XC (French)

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2026 300 XC-W
records.statement: KTM describes the 2026 300 XC-W engine as delivering "masses of low-down torque and top-end fury"; Map 1 is the standard linear, predictable map and Map 2 a more aggressive map for added throttle response, selectable only with the optional Map Select switch.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2026 KTM 300 XC-W

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2025 250 XC-W
records.statement: KTM claims the 2025 250 XC-W engine makes more torque than any previous 250 two-stroke; TBI is tuned for the smoothest, most consistent delivery in gnarly conditions; Map 1 is linear and predictable, Map 2 crisper and more explosive via the optional switch.

source.name: KTM Canada model page - 2025 KTM 250 XC-W

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2025 150 XC-W
records.statement: KTM calls the 2025 150 XC-W 'in a class of its own' with a fiery, fast-responding engine; electronically controlled TBI with a 39 mm Keihin throttle body aims for smooth, consistent delivery, and the optional map switch selects Map 1 (linear, predictable) or Map 2 (more aggressive). Weight without fuel 97.8 kg.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2025 KTM 150 XC-W

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2026 150 XC-W
records.statement: KTM calls the 2026 150 XC-W 'in a class of its own' with a fiery, fast-responding engine; electronically controlled TBI with a 39 mm Keihin throttle body aims for smooth, consistent delivery, and the optional map switch selects Map 1 (linear, predictable) or Map 2 (more aggressive). Weight without fuel 96.4 kg.

source.name: KTM New Zealand model page - 2026 KTM 150 XC-W

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2027 150 XC-W
records.statement: KTM calls the 2027 150 XC-W 'in a class of its own' with a fiery, fast-responding engine; electronically controlled TBI with a 39 mm Keihin throttle body aims for smooth, consistent delivery, and the optional map switch selects Map 1 (linear, predictable) or Map 2 (more aggressive). Weight without fuel 96.4 kg.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2027 KTM 150 XC-W

records.statement: Husqvarna says the 2024 TE 300 gains torque while keeping its high-revving character; a new 39 mm throttle body with dual injectors is positioned for more immediate response; Map 1 gives predictable linear power and Map 2 added throttle response.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles model page - TE 300 2024

records.statement: Husqvarna says the 2026 TE 150 makes impressive torque for a small two-stroke with usable enduro power; Map 1 (white) is linear and progressive for hard-pack, Map 2 (green) is more aggressive for sand and heavy conditions. Weight without fuel 100 kg, seat height 952 mm.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles USA model page - TE 150 2026

records.topic: manufacturer claims for the 2024 TBI enduro engines
records.statement: KTM said the 2024 TBI system gives "almost carburetor levels of ultra-smooth power delivery" and that the electronic power valve improves mid-range power; the 150, 250 and 300 all use a 39 mm Keihin throttle body and a 6-speed wide-ratio gearbox.

source.name: Cycle News - New 2024 KTM XC-W two-stroke off-road model specs (KTM release)

records.notes: Manufacturer release as reported by the magazine.

records.statement: Test riders found the 2024 150 XC-W pulls well low in Map 1 (you have to be a couple of gears off to bog it), builds linearly with revs with little over-rev and no sharp hit; Map 2 gets into the power faster for climbs; the TBI fueling was described as flawless.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.notes: Professional test-rider impressions, not measurements.

records.statement: Test riders found the 2024 250 XC-W has power across the whole range matched to the 6-speed, with the damped clutch softening delivery for traction; Map 2 is a big step more aggressive and can spin the rear tire unexpectedly.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.notes: Professional test-rider impressions.

records.statement: Test riders found the 2024 300 XC-W strong from just off idle through the midrange ("tractor-esque"), dropping off when over-revved; Map 1 is calm and nearly impossible to get into trouble with, Map 2 suits fast open terrain but is a handful in tight changes of direction.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.notes: Professional test-rider impressions.

records.statement: A tester found the 2022 EX 300 TPI has plenty of power and spot-on throttle response, but wanted a smoother bottom end for slow technical trail and noticed lean spots before the engine reached full temperature.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EX 300 review

records.statement: A tester described the 2022 EC 300 TPI as a little mellower than the carbureted predecessors, slightly lean-feeling until warm, and able to tractor through rugged terrain; it seemed to run better at high elevation.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EC 300 review

records.statement: A tester found the 2021 TE 300i makes lots of usable power delivered in a very linear way, all but impossible to stall at low speed; the map switch made a negligible difference, and a slightly lean feel with occasional light detonation under low-rpm load was noted.

source.name: Cycle News - 2021 Husqvarna TE 300i review

records.topic: test-rider comparison: 2023 300 XC TBI vs 300 XC-W TPI
records.statement: Comparing project bikes, a tester called the 2023 300 XC TBI "intense" with more torque and horsepower than any previous 300 he had ridden, while the 2023 300 XC-W TPI was smooth and rideable but lacked the bottom-end grunt and midrange pull of the earlier carbureted bikes; he preferred the XC-W for long tight loops.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine - Project bike shootout: KTM 300 TPI vs KTM 300 TBI

records.topic: aftermarket pipe and silencer on the 2023 300 TBI (dyno)
records.statement: On a magazine dyno an FMF Factory Fatty pipe and titanium Powercore 2.1 silencer lifted a 2023 KTM 300 SX from 54.96 to 58.08 hp (peak moved from 8,560 to 8,800 rpm) and torque from 35.38 to 36.10 lb-ft, with slightly less power from 5,800 to 6,700 rpm; riders felt more snap and bottom-end hit. The kit is listed for the 2023 250/300 XC and TX 300 as well.

source.name: Motocross Action - MXA team tested: FMF 2023 KTM 250/300SX pipe/silencer

records.notes: Measured on the 300 SX; fitment to XC/TX stated by the article. On a 2023 TC 250 the same system added just over 1 hp.

records.statement: On the 2020 TX 300i TPI a Pro Circuit pipe added about 3 hp at 7,500 rpm and about 3 hp at 9,000 rpm over the stock 48 hp engine.

source.name: Motocross Action - Race test: 2020 Husqvarna TX300i

records.statement: A plug-and-play replacement ECU for TPI KTM, Husqvarna and GasGas two-strokes (tested on a 2022 EC 300 and a 300 XC-W) made the engine run better from the bottom through the range and removed the detonation common on stock 300 TPIs; it also fed more oil and keeps the stock map-switch and warning-light functions. List price $649.99.

source.name: Cycle News - Coober USA KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas 300 TPI ECU

records.notes: Applied to the TPI years of each model only (TPI: 250/300 XC and TX 300 2020-2022, XC-W/TE 2020-2023, GasGas EX/EC 2021-2023). Not tuneable by the owner.

records.topic: TPI 300 project: head insert, ECU and suspension
records.statement: On a 2023 300 XC-W TPI project a high-compression head with a mountain insert added low-end grunt and midrange pull at altitude, and a stock-ECU reflash or replacement ECU gave a big boost in power and torque by correcting the lean fueling - the change the tester would make first.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine - Project bike shootout: KTM 300 TPI vs KTM 300 TBI

records.topic: TBI 300 XC project: making the power manageable
records.statement: On a 2023 300 XC TBI project the tester added no power; instead an auto clutch and a slower-turning throttle cam made the power more manageable, with flywheel weights planned next, and re-valved or replaced suspension was the biggest improvement.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine - Project bike shootout: KTM 300 TPI vs KTM 300 TBI

records.statement: On the 2022 EX 300 a tester slowed the power-valve opening by a little over a quarter turn to find his sweet spot, and on the EC 300 the power-valve tension is the simple tuning adjustment that replaces the KTM/Husqvarna map switch.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EX 300 review

records.notes: EC statement from the companion EC 300 review.

records.topic: fixes for a rough-running 250 XC TPI
records.statement: For a 2020 250 XC TPI that splutters at part throttle low to mid and runs rich, a magazine suggests turning in the throttle-body air screw from four turns out, asking the dealer for the latest ECU settings, or using a piggyback tuner, replacement ECU, stock-ECU reflash or a fuel-injector relocation package with a new head; it reports great results from a tested replacement ECU.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine - KTM 250 TPI issues and solutions (Mr. Know-It-All)

records.topic: carb baseline for the Mikuni TMX 38 on the 125 XC
records.statement: One forum member suggests a Yamaha-YZ125-style baseline for the Mikuni TMX 38 on the 2021-22 125 XC: air screw 2-1/4 turns, #40 pilot, 4 mm slide cutaway, 6BFY42-74 needle on the 3rd clip, S-4 needle jet, #410 main and 10 mm float level (sea level, 68 F, 30:1 premix), lowering the fuel level 1.0-1.5 mm for off-road to cut overflow losses.

source.name: ThumperTalk - Jetting the Mikuni TMX carb on 2017-2021 KTM 125/150SX and 2021-22 KTM 125XC

records.notes: Single poster, no follow-up results; differs from KTM's stock 125 XC US jetting (main 470, needle 6BFY43-75) - start from the owner's-manual settings.

records.topic: map switch and auto-calibrating power valve: 2024 and 2026 300 XC
records.statement: KTM fits the 300 XC with a map select switch as standard (Map 1 linear, Map 2 aggressive) and says the electronic exhaust-port control is auto-calibrating, so there are no power-valve adjustments; fueling is Keihin EFI with a Vitesco ECU and needs no jetting.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2026 KTM 300 XC

records.notes: Same statements appear on the 2024 page.

records.statement: KTM fits the 125 XC with a standard map switch for two perceptibly different maps and an electronically controlled, self-calibrating exhaust port; the 2023 model introduced a 39 mm throttle body with the throttle cable acting directly on it for smoother response.

source.name: KTM Canada model page - 2023 KTM 125 XC (French)

records.topic: optional map switch on TBI XC-W models
records.statement: KTM sells the Map Select switch as an optional extra on all XC-W models; without it the bikes run Map 1, the standard linear map, while Map 2 adds throttle response.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2026 KTM 300 XC-W

records.notes: Stated on the 2025-2027 150/250/300 XC-W model pages.

records.topic: map switch price and use on the 2024 XC-W range
records.statement: All 2024 XC-W models ship running Map 1; the Map 2 handlebar switch is an accessory of about $150, which testers recommended for racing on the 250 while leaving tired riders on Map 1.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.statement: Husqvarna identifies the TE 150 maps by lamp colour: Map 1 white for linear power on hard pack, Map 2 green, more aggressive, for sand and heavy going; oil is fed by an EMS-controlled electronic pump.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles USA model page - TE 150 2026

records.statement: Husqvarna says the 2024 TE 300 EMS controls an electronic oil pump that meters oil by rpm and load, an electronic exhaust control for the lateral exhaust ports, and a dual-injector 39 mm throttle body; two maps give linear (Map 1) or sharper (Map 2) response.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles model page - TE 300 2024

records.topic: no map switch on GasGas TPI 300s
records.statement: The 2022 GasGas EX 300 and EC 300 TPI come without the two-position map switch that the KTM and Husqvarna versions carry; testers did not miss it because the TPI engines are manageable as they are.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EX 300 review

records.topic: map switch effect on the 2021 TE 300i
records.statement: A tester found the difference between the two map-switch positions on the 2021 TE 300i negligible and blamed a slightly lean feel at speed on the factory emissions tune.

source.name: Cycle News - 2021 Husqvarna TE 300i review

records.topic: map switch and fuel system on the 2020 TX 300i
records.statement: The 2020 TX 300i has a two-position switch on the throttle side - two hash marks mellow, one hash mark aggressive (reversed from earlier Husqvarnas); the 39 mm throttle body meters only air so there is no jetting, and it needs injector-compatible two-stroke oil in a 700 cc tank. The importer advised against adjusting the power valve.

source.name: Motocross Action - Race test: 2020 Husqvarna TX300i

records.notes: The owner's manual lists the oil tank as approx. 0.6 l.

records.statement: KTM's 2024 XC-W range moved to throttle-body injection (39 mm Keihin) with an electronic power valve, electronic oil injection and new reed-case flaps, an independent Off-road Control Unit under the seat, a frame with parallel engine mounts and a forged shock mount, a hybrid polyamide/aluminium subframe, a hollow die-cast swingarm, WP XACT closed-cartridge fork and a redesigned WP XPLOR shock.

source.name: Cycle News - New 2024 KTM XC-W two-stroke off-road model specs (KTM release)

records.notes: Manufacturer release as reported.

records.statement: For 2026 the KTM enduro range got refreshed graphics, new damping settings with lighter, shorter fork springs and a reworked shock reservoir, a protection cap on the fuel connector against dirt and water, and a radiator cap with a standard thread.

source.name: Cycle News - New 2026 KTM XC-W enduro specs (KTM release)

records.notes: Range-wide statements in the release; model-specific attribution is implied.

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2026 TX 300 got threaded radiator caps, a fuel-line protection cap and new graphics; it keeps the 293 cc TBI engine with electronic exhaust control, 1:60 premix, 26:72 primary, 14:48 final drive and WP XACT closed-cartridge fork, at about 224.8 lb without fuel.

source.name: Cycle News - New 2026 Husqvarna TC, FX, TX specs (Husqvarna release)

records.statement: GasGas's 2026 update brought black rims and a style refresh; the EC 300 got new WP XPLOR/XACT settings, a radiator fan (now on all enduro models), rerouted two-stroke wiring harnesses and a softer tire compound, and the enduro line-up shrank to the EC 300, EC 350F and EC 500F. The EX 300 keeps ECU settings that differ from the MC models.

source.name: Enduro21 - First look 2026 GASGAS off-road range

records.notes: Manufacturer release as reported; EX-specific attribution limited.

records.statement: KTM's 2027 XC range is largely unchanged, with proven engines and six-speed gearboxes, the 125 XC back in the line-up, WP XACT closed-cartridge fork and XACT shock, and new in-mold graphics with red tank-shroud highlights.

source.name: Enduro21 - Quick look 2027 KTM XC and XC-F range

records.statement: KTM said the 2022 125 XC got a 50-tooth rear sprocket for more top speed, a direct result of customer feedback, with otherwise unchanged engine and chassis.

source.name: Enduro21 - First look 2022 KTM cross-country and motocross models

records.notes: The 2022 owner's manual still lists 13:51 for all 125 models - see conflicts.

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2024 TE 300 got a refined chromoly frame with a new shock mount no longer tied to the main tube for better anti-squat, an all-new WP XACT shock 100 g lighter and 15 mm shorter, a swingarm 190 g lighter, and an engine over 1.2 kg lighter than the previous generation.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles model page - TE 300 2024

records.statement: Testers found the 300 XC-W shares the 250's chassis but turns slightly less quickly because of its extra rotating mass; the 150 is the lightest-feeling, and a steering damper was suggested for high sixth-gear speeds on rough ground.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.statement: KTM says the 2026 300 XC-W keeps the 48 mm WP XACT closed-cartridge fork with new, shorter and lighter main springs, while the PDS shock has no hardware changes; both ends have tool-free clickers.

source.name: KTM USA model page - 2026 KTM 300 XC-W

records.notes: The 2026 release describes the spring/damping update as range-wide.

records.statement: Testers found the 2024 150 XC-W suspension softer and plusher than the 250/300, while the 250/300 resisted bottoming and stayed consistent when pushed; the 150 needs more shifting because its clutch has no damping function.

source.name: Ultimate Motorcycling - 2024 KTM XC-W lineup test (300, 250 and 150 reviewed)

records.statement: For motocross-style riding testers ran the 2020 TX 300i air fork at 145 psi (stock 139), 12 clicks out compression and rebound, fork on the 3rd line; shock 42 N/mm spring, high-speed compression 1-1/4 turns out, low-speed 8 clicks, rebound 14 clicks, 105 mm race sag (102-108 mm sweet spot). Raising the forks cured front-end push.

source.name: Motocross Action - Race test: 2020 Husqvarna TX300i

records.topic: suspension baseline notes: 2022 GasGas EX 300 / EC 300
records.statement: Testers found the 2022 EX 300's WP XACT air fork and shock jarringly stiff out of the box for trail use and needing constant attention, while the EC 300's coil-spring XPLOR suspension is trail-oriented and suits riders up to about 170 lb.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EX 300 review

records.notes: EC statement from the companion EC 300 review.

records.statement: A 165 lb tester found the 2021 TE 300i coil-spring XPLOR suspension cushy and excellent in rocks, but likely too soft for heavier riders or aggressive high-speed riding.

source.name: Cycle News - 2021 Husqvarna TE 300i review

records.topic: 2020 TX 300i fuel cut-out when low on fuel
records.statement: Testers found that whipping the 2020 TX 300i left-side-up while low on fuel could make the engine quit, a fuel-pickup issue; they also disliked the 18-inch AT81 rear tire for motocross.

source.name: Motocross Action - Race test: 2020 Husqvarna TX300i

records.statement: A tester noted occasional light detonation under low-rpm load and a slightly lean feel at speed on the 2021 TE 300i, attributed to the emissions tune; it also has no cooling fan or kick-start backup.

source.name: Cycle News - 2021 Husqvarna TE 300i review

records.topic: 2022 GasGas EC 300 front brake and protection
records.statement: Testers found the 2022 EC 300 front brake the weak point (firm lever but less stopping power than the Brembo/Magura siblings) and noted it comes without handguards or a skid plate; range is about 100 miles of mellow trail from the 2.3 gal tank.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EC 300 review

records.statement: Testers noted the 2022 EX 300 comes without handguards or a skid plate, has vulnerable exhaust pipes and an air fork needing frequent checks, and showed lean spots before full temperature.

source.name: Cycle News - 2022 GasGas EX 300 review

records.statement: A 2020 250 XC TPI owner reported a spluttery engine at part throttle from low to mid rpm with a flat top end and signs of rich running; the magazine recommends checking the throttle-body air screw and getting the latest ECU settings from the dealer first.

source.name: Dirt Bike Magazine - KTM 250 TPI issues and solutions (Mr. Know-It-All)

records.statement: GasGas rerouted the wiring harnesses on its 2026 two-strokes for improved reliability.

source.name: Enduro21 - First look 2026 GASGAS off-road range

records.topic: manufacturer description of power and maps: 2027 XC two-strokes
records.statement: KTM says the 2027 XC models have a map select switch as standard: Map 1 gives linear, predictable power and Map 2 "the full beans with crisp, explosive power output"; it calls the 300 XC a 300 cc powerhouse with e-start, fuel injection and electronic exhaust control, and lists 101.8 kg without fuel and a 23.8 kg engine.

source.name: KTM South Africa model page - 2027 KTM 300 XC

records.notes: Map statement is made for the XC range on the 300 XC page. The 2027 owner's manual lists 103 kg for all XC models.

records.statement: Husqvarna describes the 2027 TE 150 engine as very versatile, fed by a 39 mm throttle body with two injectors (one low-load, one top-feed) and an EMS-controlled oil pump; Map 1 (white) is linear and progressive for hard pack, Map 2 (green) more aggressive for sand and heavy conditions. Weight without fuel 100 kg.

source.name: Total Motorcycle - 2027 Husqvarna TE150 (reproduces Husqvarna release and feature text)

records.notes: Text reproduced by a third-party site from Husqvarna material.

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 enduro update brought white powder-coated frames, new graphics, WP XACT closed-cartridge fork and XACT shock, and a threaded radiator cap for checking coolant before each ride, with a 12-month warranty in selected markets.

source.name: Total Motorcycle - 2027 Husqvarna TE150 (reproduces Husqvarna release and feature text)

records.notes: Press-release text reproduced by a third-party site.

records.topic: rear-wheel dyno: TBI EX 300 engine (2024 measurement)
records.statement: A 2024 GasGas EX 300 measured 50.1 hp and 33.1 lb-ft on a rear-wheel Dynojet 250i; the 2025-2027 EX 300 owner's manuals list the same TBI engine data (bore, stroke, Z dimension, primary drive).

source.name: Dirt Rider - 2024 GasGas EX 300 dyno test (Dynojet 250i)

records.notes: Measured on the 2024 bike; applied to later years only because the manuals show the same engine data. ECU calibration changes are not published.

conflicts.note: KTM Owner's Manual 2024 150 EXC 150 XC-W (art. no. 3214837en) prints wheelbase 1,890 ± 10 mm; neighbouring-year manuals for the same chassis list about 1,488-1,489 mm, so the figure is treated as a misprint and not used.

KTM Owner's Manual 2024 250 EXC 250 EXC SIX DAYS 250 XC-W 300 EXC 300 EXC SIX DAYS (art. no. 3214838en) prints wheelbase 1,890 ± 10 mm; neighbouring-year manuals for the same chassis list about 1,488-1,489 mm, so the figure is treated as a misprint and not used.
Both on the 2023 300 SX; different dynos and correction factors. Kept side by side, not averaged.

values.owner's manual: super unleaded 98 octane premixed 1:40, no oil pump
values.KTM Canada model page: claims the end of oil-fuel premixing

conflicts.note: The model-page copy appears carried over from the oil-injected enduro models; the manual is followed.
Manual figure used in the gearing records.

values.2024 owner's manual: XPLOR PRO 7548 with a 5 bar air pressure entry

conflicts.note: Possible manual error; kept as printed with medium confidence.

not_found: No manufacturer horsepower or torque figures are published for the US XC, XC-W, TX, TE, EX or EC two-strokes.
No independent dyno found for the TBI XC-W / TE / EC enduro engines, the 150 XC-W / TE 150 (TPI or TBI), the 2021-22 carbureted 125 XC, or the TPI 250/300 XC and XC-W.
Older (2020-2022) owner's manuals use a required/recommended-work table that could not be parsed reliably, so service intervals are given only for 2023-2027 manuals.
The 2025-2026 150 XC-W and TE 150 owner's manuals print the gear-ratio table as an image; ratios were not taken from them.
No 2027 owner's manual for the GasGas EC 250 / EX 250 or Husqvarna TE 250 US was found (models not in the 2027 US range).
No aftermarket engine-mod test found specifically for the TBI 150 XC-W / TE 150 or the TBI 125 XC.
Several KTM US model pages (2026 250 XC, en-us 2026 150 XC-W) could not be fetched; other-region pages or press releases were used instead.
